prompt: Two figures both fully visible from head to knee, the same size, in a near-monochrome desaturated grey dungeon. On the left a masked assassin in tattered black leather and a charcoal hood lunges in a low crouch facing east, his slim curved dagger pressed to the throat of the man on the right, a soldier in greyish steel plate who is buckling backward off balance, knees bending, eyes wide and mouth agape in shock. A single line of crimson blood wells from the shallow nick on the soldier's neck and runs down his collar. The crimson blood and one cold glint on the blade are the only bright accents. The background is a soot-stained black stone wall lit by one faint distant torch.

An assassin in a hooded charcoal-black cloak stepping silently out of pitch-dark shadow behind an unaware nobleman in a wine-purple coat, one gloved hand reaching toward the nobleman's neck, the assassin's fingertips and slim dagger-tip coated in glowing sickly toxic-green venom. The toxic-green glow is the only source of light, casting a faint green rim on the assassin's hood and on the nobleman's startled face as he begins to turn. The background is near-black shadow, a dim moonlit window far behind them, almost monochrome desaturated grey-blue.
